Microsoft Office documents (Light titles, Bold subtitles, Regular body)

logo_usage.clear_space: X on every side, where X is the height and width of a square set from the logo drawing (page 8 and 9).
logo_usage.min_size: 25 mm wide with strapline; 15 mm wide without strapline.
logo_usage.background_rules: Monochrome (black or white) logo goes on a solid colour background or a photo with a dark overlay; the black version may be coloured deep blue where graphically suitable. Colour logo uses the gradient.
logo_usage.misuse: Do not distort, stretch or skew; do not rotate; always use the star; do not resize or move elements; respect clear space; do not change the gradient or colours; do not redraw, always use the latest approved files.

notes: Gradients per the charter: light blue to deep blue, and grass green to light blue. Charter also defines project colour schemes, which are the same four colours.
